ui_guidance: Follow the supplied app design, wordmark, mascot, fonts and palette. Composite controlled UI layers. Supplied reference screens contain AI-generated badges; these must not appear in the commercial's screen compositions. Use The idea / The result for the comparison.

crime_meter.label: Weirdness level / Food Felony
crime_meter.distinction: Creation setting is 100/100. The source recipe's database Crime Level is 92/100; do not rewrite that stored score.

continuity: One fictional adult cook, one kitchen, consistent clothing, consistent dish. Scripted reaction performers. Commercial dramatization disclosure on comparison, without AI labels.
cost_note: Previous total estimate was 352 credits for 22 seconds of 1080p footage. Recheck the revised 8/6/4/4-second shot allocation before generation.

flow.title: Maximum crime
flow.visual: Close-up of the person's thumb dragging the app's Weirdness / Food Felony meter to 100/100. Red pulse and an immediate bass hit. No typing or prompt entry.

flow.title: Dish reveal
flow.visual: The vegetable gelatin concept image snaps onto the phone. Brief over-the-shoulder shot establishes the person holding it.

flow.title: The grin
flow.visual: Cut to the same person's face. They glance from phone toward the ingredients, pause, then give a mischievous grin.

flow.title: Ingredients
flow.visual: Quick overhead ingredient reveal: gelatin, celery, green pepper and onion land on the counter in time with the beat.

flow.title: Cook it
flow.visual: Same person and kitchen: rapid cuts of chopping vegetables, whisking gelatin, pouring into a ring mold, then unmolding the wobbling finished dish after a visible time jump.

flow.title: Compare and share
flow.visual: Phone displays the polished concept image beside the original archive dish photo as a staged result. The person taps Share; the paired post appears in a fictional feed.

flow.title: Everyone reacts
flow.visual: Fast reaction close-ups build into a nine-person grid: shock, laughter, delight and playful horror. Guilty / Acquitted stamps punctuate the beat.

flow.title: Brand and download
flow.visual: Supplied Food Felonies wordmark, chef mascot, warm paper background and red download button.
flow.screen_text: Make it. Cook it. Show the evidence.
